title: The Cup of Cocoa with Two Handles of Steam
youtube_title: The Cup of Cocoa with Two Handles of Steam | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Jorie sees that a wide cup of cocoa sending up steam for two noses will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Jorie makes a smaller, even share so Eitan is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
